notes.notes: [h1]Infinite Einstein Tiles 2 Under Development![/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45593807/b16503a8c30d0832666120d308288fa2c9c60181.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45593807/41ec6f20bccefc8206875c0e1ce2176ebe81842d.png"][/img][/p][p]Development of Infinite Einstein Tiles 2, featuring turtle tiles that pair with hat tiles, has begun.[/p][p]A discounted bundle including both titles will also be available for purchase![/p]
